jobs.title: Country Head / QA Director (Manila)
jobs.description:
Testronic is a global leader in Quality Assurance and technology services for the games and entertainment industries. We work with some of the world's leading game developers and publishers, providing Functional QA, Compliance QA, Localization QA, Compatibility QA, and other specialized services. 

With diverse teams across Europe, Asia, and North America, we foster an inclusive, collaborative culture built on four core values: We Care Deeply, Passion for Quality, Trust in Unity, and Pride in Ownership. Whether you're starting your career or looking for your next challenge, Testronic offers opportunities to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact. 

We are looking for an experienced Country Head / QA Director to lead our Manila operations and drive the site's operational, financial, and organisational performance. You will work closely with the COO, Global Function Leaders, Commercial teams, and other senior stakeholders to ensure Manila delivers against Testronic's global strategy while meeting local business and customer needs. 

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Global & Site Operations:

  • Lead the overall performance and development of the Manila site in line with Testronic's global strategy. 
  • Lead the Manila site reset, focusing on operational excellence, efficiency, cost management, and employee engagement. 
  • Ensure the right people, space, hardware, IT, and operational capacity are available to support current and future business demand. 
  • Balance productivity, utilisation, capacity, and cost efficiency. 
  • Collaborate with global and local leaders to ensure effective cross-functional delivery. 

Organisational Leadership:

  • Establish and maintain an effective Manila leadership and operating structure. 
  • Optimise the Manila test floor operating model while supporting the development of Testronic's wider global operating model. 
  • Drive operational consistency and performance in line with global standards. 
  • Develop and coach the local leadership team and support talent development and succession planning. 
  • Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and high performance. 

Commercial & Customer Partnership:

  • Partner with Commercial and Solutions teams to support new business, pilots, revenue growth, and customer delivery. 
  • Ensure Manila has the operational capability and capacity to support new business opportunities. 
  • Lead local teams in delivering exceptional levels of customer satisfaction. 
  • Support strategic customer relationships and local customer escalations when required. 

Financial & Business Performance:

  • Own the Manila country P&L and deliver performance against agreed budgets and targets. 
  • Manage local operating costs and CAPEX effectively. 
  • Monitor operational performance and identify opportunities to improve productivity, utilisation, and profitability. 
  • Ensure costs remain aligned with business requirements and revenue. 
  • Use operational and financial data to identify risks and opportunities and support informed decision-making. 

People & Culture:

  • Provide effective leadership and line management to senior local teams. 
  • Support the implementation of Testronic's Global Competency Model and performance frameworks. 
  • Drive employee engagement, development, and retention. 
  • Work with the CEO, CPTO, and People teams to deliver consistent employee communications and initiatives at site level. 
  • Lead by example and promote Testronic's values and culture across the Manila organisation. 

Risk Management & Business Continuity:

  • Lead local risk management, governance, and compliance in partnership with relevant global functions. 
  • Ensure compliance with local legislation and Testronic policies. 
  • Maintain effective Business Continuity and operational resilience plans. 
  • Ensure Manila is prepared to respond to operational disruption, technology outages, workforce risks, and other business continuity challenges. 
  • Support regular risk assessments, continuity testing, and contingency planning. 

Global Collaboration & Reporting:

  • Work closely with the COO and Global Operations leadership on reporting, processes, and operating model development. 
  • Provide accurate operational and business information to support global decision-making. 
  • Share Manila insights and best practices to support continuous improvement across Testronic. 
  • Collaborate across functions and countries to deliver the company's strategy and business plan. 

 

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in Gaming QA with proven ability to lead and coach this at scale.  
  • Deep experience in building, developing, and scaling large QA teams 
  • Significant senior leadership experience in a large-scale, operational environment. 
  • Proven experience leading a country, site, business unit, or large operational function. 
  • Strong commercial and financial understanding, including P&L, budgeting, and cost management. 
  • Experience leading organisational change, transformation, or operational improvement. 
  • Experience managing large, diverse, and multi-disciplinary teams. 
  • Strong understanding of workforce planning, capacity management, productivity, and cost optimisation. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
  • Strong customer and commercial mindset. 
  • Ability to operate effectively within a global, matrix organisation. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. 
  • A collaborative, accountable, and people-focused leadership style

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description:
Testronic is a global leader in Quality Assurance and technology services for the games and entertainment industries. We work with some of the world's leading game developers and publishers, providing Functional QA, Compliance QA, Localization QA, Compatibility QA, and other specialized services. 

With diverse teams across Europe, Asia, and North America, we foster an inclusive, collaborative culture built on four core values: We Care Deeply, Passion for Quality, Trust in Unity, and Pride in Ownership. Whether you're starting your career or looking for your next challenge, Testronic offers opportunities to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact. 

About the Role 

We are looking for a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead Testronic’s information and cyber security programme at a global level. The CISO will define and deliver the security strategy, oversee enterprise security risk and governance, lead the Information Security function, and provide senior leadership and Board-level advice on cyber security, resilience and compliance. 

Responsibilities:

Information Security Strategy 

  • Develop and deliver Testronic’s global information security strategy, aligned with business objectives, technology plans and risk appetite. 
  • Translate security objectives into measurable programmes, capabilities and annual priorities. 
  • Monitor the security landscape and adapt the strategy to emerging threats, technology and regulatory requirements. 

Governance & Risk Management 

  • Own the global information security governance framework, policies and risk management processes. 
  • Ensure material security risks have clear ownership, treatment plans and appropriate escalation. 
  • Oversee the Information Security Management System and promote security accountability across the organisation. 

Board & Senior Leadership 

  • Provide clear, regular reporting to the Board and senior leadership on cyber risk, security posture, incidents, compliance and resilience. 
  • Advise executives on significant security risks and support informed business decisions. 
  • Communicate complex security topics in clear business and financial terms. 

Security & Incident Management 

  • Act as the senior escalation point for significant information security incidents. 
  • Lead or support executive-level response to major cyber incidents, working with IT, Legal, Privacy, Communications and business teams. 
  • Ensure incident response exercises, lessons learned and remediation activities are effectively managed. 

Security Programme & Assurance 

  • Oversee security programmes covering corporate technology, cloud, applications, products and third parties. 
  • Provide oversight of security architecture, vulnerabilities, penetration testing, control testing and independent assurance. 
  • Monitor the effectiveness of internal and outsourced security services and ensure key security improvements are delivered. 

Compliance & External Stakeholders 

  • Oversee information security requirements arising from legislation, regulations, customer contracts and recognised standards. 
  • Support ISO 27001 and other relevant certification and assurance programmes. 
  • Represent Testronic in significant security matters involving clients, auditors, regulators, insurers and other external stakeholders. 

Leadership & Business Partnership 

  • Lead, develop and build a capable global Information Security function. 
  • Work closely with IT, Legal, HR, Facilities, Commercial, QA and other departments to embed security into business and technology decisions. 
  • Manage the security budget, strategic suppliers and major security investments. 
  • Ensure security risks are considered in acquisitions, outsourcing and major organisational or technology changes. 

Requirements

  • Significant senior-level experience in information and cyber security. 
  • Experience developing and implementing an enterprise security strategy. 
  • Experience advising Boards, executives or senior governance committees. 
  • Strong experience in enterprise security risk management and governance. 
  • Experience leading security programmes across complex technology environments. 
  • Experience managing significant cyber security incidents or crisis situations. 
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary security teams. 
  • Strong understanding of security governance, architecture, operations, assurance and operational resilience. 
  • Knowledge of cloud, infrastructure, identity, application and product security. 
  • Experience with security frameworks, ISO 27001 and third-party risk. 
  • Strong stakeholder, programme, budget and supplier management skills. 
  • Knowledge of relevant UK legal, regulatory and contractual requirements. 

GOOD TO HAVE: CISSP, CISM, CCISO, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, CRISC or equivalent qualifications.

jobs.title: LQA Game Tester with Japanese
jobs.description:
Testronic is a global leader in Quality Assurance and technology services for the games and entertainment industries. We work with some of the world's leading game developers and publishers, providing Functional QA, Compliance QA, Localization QA, Compatibility QA, and other specialized services.

With diverse teams across Europe, Asia, and North America, we foster an inclusive, collaborative culture built on four core values: We Care Deeply, Passion for Quality, Trust in Unity, and Pride in Ownership. Whether you're starting your career or looking for your next challenge, Testronic offers opportunities to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.

Join our Localization Quality Assurance department and be responsible for:

  • Finding and correcting any translation errors, spelling mistakes and ambiguities.
  • Checking the game’s tone and style, audio, text, and cultural correctness.
  • Creating reports in Excel and Jira.
  • Submitting quality improving suggestions for the errors you find.

Requirements

  • Japanese C2 level or native.
  • English C1 level to ensure internal communication and reporting.
  • Perfect knowledge of grammar, spelling, and punctuation of your language.
  • Good MS Office skills, especially Excel.
  • Great communication skills allowing to express yourself precise and clearly.
  • Ability to work in a team and under pressure of time.

You can score extra points for:

  • Passion for gaming and curiosity for new titles (all types of games count!).
  • Experience in game testing, translation, or linguistic game testing.
  • Familiarity of platforms like Sony (PS4/PS5), Microsoft (PC, Xbox One/XSX/XSS), Nintendo (Switch), Apple (iOS).

Benefits

  • Casual contract with flexible projects and competitive salary.
  • A chance to get your foot in the door of the gaming industry, where you'll gain experience and develop skills in language testing methodologies and techniques.
  • A friendly and collaborative work environment, where we work together to achieve great quality in upcoming titles.
  • Informal, international, and multicultural environment, where you'll meet people from all around the world.
  • Online training platforms and workshops to help you grow with us.

The rest is on us!

If you are interested in exploring the gaming industry, APPLY today and let's make great games together!
